app.name: Tunnelgate
dashboard.title: Tunnels
dashboard.empty: No tunnels found for this account.
dashboard.offline: You are offline. Tunnel status is hidden until the connection is back.
tunnel.local: Locally managed: routes are read-only here
route.disabled.no_zone_access: The API token has no access to this zone
confirm.killAll.title: Block every route?
confirm.killAll.body: Every route that can be blocked, in every tunnel, will stop answering from the internet. Internal access is not affected.
confirm.blockTunnel.title: Block all routes in {tunnel}?
confirm.blockTunnel.body: Every route of this tunnel that can be blocked will stop answering from the internet.
confirm.critical.title: Block a critical route?
confirm.critical.body: {host} is marked as critical. Blocking it may break sign-in or other services that depend on it.
confirm.undo.title: Undo the last change in {tunnel}?
confirm.undo.body: Restores the previous ingress configuration of this tunnel. DNS records and block rules are not changed.
clone.title: Clone route
clone.serviceHelp: Where cloudflared sends the traffic, as seen from the tunnel.
clone.createBlockedHelp: The route exists but stays unreachable until you allow it.
clone.summary: Adds an ingress rule to {tunnel} before the catch-all and creates the DNS record for {host}. A snapshot of the current config is saved first.
clone.invalidSubdomain: Use letters, digits and hyphens only.
clone.invalidService: Use http, https, tcp, ssh or rdp with a host, e.g. http://app:8080.
remove.title: Remove route
remove.body: This deletes the ingress rule and the DNS record for this route in {tunnel}. A snapshot of the tunnel config is saved first, so it can be undone.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Preferences are saved on this device only.
settings.languageHelp: Automatic uses your device language, falling back to English.
settings.createBlockedHelp: New routes start blocked so you can test them before exposing.
settings.hideDestHelp: Hides service URLs on cards, useful when sharing your screen.
settings.orderHelp: How routes are sorted inside each tunnel.
denied.title: Access denied
denied.body: You are signed in, but your account is not allowed to use Tunnelgate.
denied.recorded: This attempt was recorded. If you should have access, ask an administrator to add you to the right group.
signedOut.title: You are signed out
